claims.claim_ar: مقابلة حالتين ببناء متوازٍ يبدأ بـ «إِذَا» لتوظيف التوازي والتدرج التأصيلي: حالة الخشية عند ذكرِ الله وحالة الزيادة في الإيمان عند تلاوة الآيات.

claims.needs_review_reason: Inferred from a commentary substring that cites a similar conditional clause; the exact ayah wording is not present verbatim in the chunks, so the linkage should be verified against primary balāghah sources.

claims.claim_en: Repetition of the conditional particle 'إِذَا' as a rhetorical device to link successive states and highlight continuity and reinforcing effect.
claims.needs_review_reason: Claim based on commentary occurrence of the clause; confirm that the function of repetition is intended in classical balāghah treatments of this verse.
